name: io.github.pdxlab/mcp-trust-proxy
description: Drop a TrustModel trust layer in front of any MCP server — verifies the caller's AgentCert + TrustScore inbound and scores the upstream outbound, per tools/call. Shadow by default; ~0.4 ms added per verify.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PROXY_UPSTREAM
environmentVariables.description: The MCP server to front, e.g. http://host:9000/mcp

environmentVariables.name: TAG_MODE
environmentVariables.description: shadow (verify + log, block nothing — default) or enforce

environmentVariables.name: TAG_FAIL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: On a verification error: closed (deny, default) or open

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PROXY_TRUST_INDEX_URL
environmentVariables.description: Trust Index API base for live upstream scores
